# rle

## Description

Compresse/décompresse du texte. Implémente la méthode
[RLE](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Codage_par_plages) sur les mots d'une
ligne.

Par exemple, "foo foo\nbar bar bar" sera compressé en "2 foo \n3 bar \n".

## Usage

```text
$ cat data/image0.pnm 
P2
# generated by drawlib
3 4
255
255 255 255 255
255 0 0 255
255 255 255 255

$ ./build/rle.out compress data/image0.pnm out0.rle
2025-11-03 16:32:27.194 INFO  [10658] [main@27] opening data/image0.pnm
2025-11-03 16:32:27.194 INFO  [10658] [main@35] opening out0.rle
2025-11-03 16:32:27.194 INFO  [10658] [main@43] running compress
2025-11-03 16:32:27.194 INFO  [10658] [main@55] ok

$ cat out0.rle 
1 P2
1 # 1 generated 1 by 1 drawlib
1 3 1 4
1 255
4 255
1 255 2 0 1 255
4 255

$ ./build/rle.out decompress out0.rle out0.pnm
2025-11-03 16:33:10.339 INFO  [10684] [main@27] opening out0.rle
2025-11-03 16:33:10.339 INFO  [10684] [main@35] opening out0.pnm
2025-11-03 16:33:10.339 INFO  [10684] [main@47] running decompress
2025-11-03 16:33:10.339 INFO  [10684] [main@55] ok

$ cat out0.pnm 
P2 
# generated by drawlib 
3 4 
255 
255 255 255 255 
255 0 0 255 
255 255 255 255 
```

## Gestion d'erreurs

```text
$ ./build/rle.out 
2025-11-03 16:31:46.231 ERROR [10638] [main@20] invalid arguments
usage: <compress/decompress> <input file> <output file>

$ ./build/rle.out foobar data/image0.pnm out0.rle
2025-11-03 16:32:13.933 INFO  [10649] [main@27] opening data/image0.pnm
2025-11-03 16:32:13.933 INFO  [10649] [main@35] opening out0.rle
2025-11-03 16:32:13.934 ERROR [10649] [main@51] unknown command: foobar
usage: <compress/decompress> <input file> <output file>

$ ./build/rle.out decompress out0.foobar out0.pnm
2025-11-03 16:33:05.810 INFO  [10677] [main@27] opening out0.foobar
2025-11-03 16:33:05.811 ERROR [10677] [main@30] cannot open file
usage: <compress/decompress> <input file> <output file>
```
